siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā
div.quote: Learn from me, only in brief, O son of Kuntī! how one who has obtained perfection attains the Brahman , which is the highest culmination of knowledge.

div.ab: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्यात्मानं नियम्य च। शब्दादीन्विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च ॥
buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyātmānaṃ niyamya ca śabdādīnviṣayāṃstyaktvā rāgadveṣau vyudasya ca
div.quote: A man possessed of a pure understanding, controlling his self by courage, discarding sound and other objects of sense, casting off affection and aversion who frequents clean places

div.ab: विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः। ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः ॥
viviktasevī laghvāśī yatavākkāyamānasaḥ dhyānayogaparo nityaṃ vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ
div.quote: who eats little whose speech body and mind are restrained who is always intent on meditation and mental abstraction and has recourse to unconcern

div.ab: अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्। विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥
ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto brahmabhūyāya kalpate
div.quote: who abandoning egoism stubbornness arrogance desire anger

div.ab: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति। समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम् ॥
brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṃ labhate parām
div.quote: and (all) belongings has no (thought that this or that is) mine and who is tranquil becomes fit for assimilation with the Brahman. Thus reaching the Brahman, and with a tranquil self, he grieves not, wishes not

div.ab: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः। ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम् ॥
bhaktyā māmabhijānāti yāvānyaścāsmi tattvataḥ tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram
div.quote: but being alike to all beings, obtains the highest devotion to me. By (that) devotion he truly understands who I am and how great. And then understanding me truly, he forthwith enters into my (essence).

div.ab: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः। मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् ॥
sarvakarmāṇyapi sadā kurvāṇo madvyapāśrayaḥ matprasādādavāpnoti śāśvataṃ padamavyayam
div.quote: Even performing all actions, always depending on me, he, through my favour, obtains the imperishable and eternal seat.

div.ab: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः। बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव ॥
cetasā sarvakarmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparaḥ buddhiyogamupāśritya maccittaḥ satataṃ bhava
div.quote: Dedicating in thought all actions to me, be constantly given up to me, (placing) your thoughts on me, through recourse to mental abstraction.

div.ab: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि। अथ चेत्त्वमहंकारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि ॥
maccittaḥ sarvadurgāṇi matprasādāttariṣyasi atha cettvamahaṃkārānna śroṣyasi vinaṅkṣyasi
div.quote: (Placing) your thoughts on me, you will cross over all difficulties by my favour. But if you will not listen through egotism, you will be ruined.

div.ab: यदहंकारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे। मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति ॥
yadahaṃkāramāśritya na yotsya iti manyase mithyaiṣa vyavasāyaste prakṛtistvāṃ niyokṣyati
div.quote: If entertaining egotism, you think that you may not fight, vain, indeed, is that resolution of yours. Nature will constrain you. That

div.ab: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा। कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोपि तत् ॥
svabhāvajena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā kartuṃ necchasi yanmohātkariṣyasyavaśopi tat
div.quote: O son of Kuntī! which through delusion you do not wish to do you will do involuntarily tied down by your own duty flowing from your nature.

div.ab: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति। भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया ॥
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛddeśe.arjuna tiṣṭhati bhrāmayansarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā
div.quote: The lord

div.ab: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत। तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम् ॥
tameva śaraṇaṃ gaccha sarvabhāvena bhārata tatprasādātparāṃ śāntiṃ sthānaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam
div.quote: O Arjuna! is seated in the region of the heart of all beings turning round all beings (as though) mounted on a machine by his delusion. With him O descendant of Bharata! seek shelter in every way by his favour you will obtain the highest tranquillity, the eternal seat.

div.ab: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया। विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ॥
iti te jñānamākhyātaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ mayā vimṛśyaitadaśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru
div.quote: Thus have I declared to you the knowledge more mysterious than any mystery. Ponder over it thoroughly, and then act as you like.

div.ab: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः। इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् ॥
sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ iṣṭo.asi me dṛḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam
div.quote: Once more, listen to my excellent words-most mysterious of all. Strongly I like you therefore I will declare what is for your welfare. On me (place) your mind become my devotee

div.ab: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु। मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे ॥
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo.asi me
div.quote: sacrifice to me reverence me you will certainly come to me. I declare to you truly, you are dear to me.

div.ab: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज। अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥
sarvadharmānparityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ahaṃ tvāṃ sarvapāpebhyo mokṣyayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
div.quote: Forsaking all duties, come to me as (your) sole refuge. I will release you from all sins. Be not grieved.

div.ab: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन। न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति ॥
idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo.abhyasūyati
div.quote: This you should never declare to one who performs no penance who is not a devotee nor to one who does not wait on (some preceptor) nor yet to one who calumniates me.

div.ab: य इदं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति। भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः ॥
ya idaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ madbhakteṣvabhidhāsyati bhaktiṃ mayi parāṃ kṛtvā māmevaiṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ
div.quote: He who, with the highest devotion to me, will proclaim this supreme mystery among my devotees, will come to me, freed from (all) doubt.

div.ab: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः। भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि ॥
na ca tasmānmanuṣyeṣu kaścinme priyakṛttamaḥ bhavitā na ca me tasmādanyaḥ priyataro bhuvi
div.quote: No one amongst men is superior to him in doing what is dear to me. And there will never be another on earth dearer to me than he. And he who will study this holy dialogue of ours will

div.ab: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः। ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः ॥
adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādamāvayoḥ jñānayajñena tenāhamiṣṭaḥ syāmiti me matiḥ
div.quote: such is my opinion have offered to me the sacrifice of knowledge. And the man

div.ab: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयादपि यो नरः। सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम् ॥
śraddhāvānanasūyaśca śṛṇuyādapi yo naraḥ so.api muktaḥ śubhā.Nllokānprāpnuyātpuṇyakarmaṇām
div.quote: also

div.ab: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा। कच्चिदज्ञानसम्मोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय ॥
kaccidetacchrutaṃ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa cetasā kaccidajñānasammohaḥ pranaṣṭaste dhanañjaya
div.quote: who with faith and without carping will listen (to this) will be freed (from sin) and attain to the holy regions of those who perform pious acts. Have you listened to this O son of Pṛthā! with a mind (fixed) on (this) one point only? Has your delusion (caused) by ignorance been destroyed O Dhanañjaya?

div.ab: अर्जुन उवाच। नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत। स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव ॥
arjuna uvāca naṣṭo mohaḥ smṛtirlabdhā tvatprasādānmayācyuta sthito.asmi gatasandehaḥ kariṣye vacanaṃ tava
div.quote: Destroyed is my delusion by your favour, O undegraded one! I (now) recollect myself. I stand freed from doubts. I will do your bidding.

div.ab: सञ्जय उवाच। इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः। संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् ॥
sañjaya uvāca ityahaṃ vāsudevasya pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ saṃvādamimamaśrauṣamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam
div.quote: Thus did I hear this dialogue between Vāsudeva and the high-minded son of Pṛthā, (a dialogue) wonderful and causing the hair to stand on end.

div.ab: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम्। योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम् ॥
vyāsaprasādācchrutavānetadguhyamahaṃ param yogaṃ yogeśvarātkṛṣṇātsākṣātkathayataḥ svayam
div.quote: By the favour of Vyāsa I heard this highest mystery, (this) devotion from Kṛṣṇa himself the lord of the possessors of mystic power who proclaimed it in person.

div.ab: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम्। केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
rājansaṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya saṃvādamimamadbhutam keśavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṃ hṛṣyāmi ca muhurmuhuḥ
div.quote: O king! remembering and (again) remembering this wonderful and holy dialogue of Keśava and Arjuna

div.ab: तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः। विस्मयो मे महान् राजन्हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः ॥
tacca saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya rūpamatyadbhutaṃ hareḥ vismayo me mahān rājanhṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ
div.quote: I rejoice over and over again. And remembering and (again) remembering that excessively wonderful form of Hari also great is my amazement O king! and I rejoice over and over again.

div.ab: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः। तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम ॥
yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ tatra śrīrvijayo bhūtirdhruvā nītirmatirmama
div.quote: Wherever (is) Kṛṣṇa the lord of the possessors of mystic power wherever (is the (great) archer the son of Prithā there in my opinion (are) fortune victory prosperity and eternal justice.
